samples.question: The picture shows seventeen identical dots on a plain background: thirteen are grey and exactly four are coloured red, orange, green and blue. Ignore the colours and look only at where the dots are. Exactly one straight line, which is not drawn anywhere in the picture, acts as a mirror for the whole arrangement: reflecting every dot across that line lands it on another dot, with a single exception. That one exception dot has no mirror partner, and it is always one of the four coloured dots. Which colour is the dot without a mirror partner? Answer red, orange, green or blue.
